# Rotate Image

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Rotates an image a certain degree.

## Syntax

~~~~text
rotateImage(image: <#Variable#>, degrees: <#Number (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
rotateImage(image: Clipboard, degrees: 180)
~~~~
